entries.description: A personal intelligence dashboard that visualizes and searches daily ATLAS logs co-created with ChatGPT. Auto-updates when atlas.json is pushed to GitHub. Tracks daily signals across Marketing, AI, and business categories.
representativeQueries: what are today's marketing news highlights
track daily AI and marketing industry signals
find recent articles about digital advertising trends
show me today's business intelligence summary

entries.description: Analyzes note.com RSS feeds to reveal writing style, theme evolution, and worldview with AI. Supports whole-blog and single-article tab views. Multi-AI support: Claude, GPT-4o, Gemini.
representativeQueries: analyze the writing style of a note.com blog
track how themes have changed across blog posts
summarize the worldview of a note author
compare recent articles on note.com

entries.description: A thought exploration tool where AI generates question cards from any input. Each card selection deepens the thinking. Two modes: expand (広げる) and narrow (絞る). Multi-AI support.
representativeQueries: help me think deeper about a problem
generate questions to explore an idea
drill down into a strategic question
expand my thinking on a topic

entries.description: A tool for synthesizing and merging multiple JSON files with AI. Supports Claude, Gemini, and GPT-4o.
representativeQueries: merge multiple JSON files into one
synthesize JSON data from different sources
combine and reconcile JSON structures with AI

entries.description: A Gen Z trend tracking dashboard with 33+ weeks of weekly signal data, 1,100+ articles, and keyword analysis. Tracks emerging Gen Z behaviors, values, and cultural signals for marketing strategy in Japan.
representativeQueries: what are the latest Gen Z trends in Japan
analyze Gen Z consumer behavior signals
find Gen Z keywords for marketing campaigns
track weekly youth culture signals in Japan

entries.displayName: Z世代 Signal Dashboard — Team View
entries.description: Team-optimized view of the Gen Z Signal Dashboard. Same data as personal view with a layout designed for team sharing and presentations within GMSD at Rakuten.
representativeQueries: show team-facing Gen Z trend summary
get Gen Z insights for a marketing team
share weekly youth culture signals with the team

entries.description: A conversational tool for dialoguing with AI-generated Gen Z personas. Select a character from the persona library and experience realistic conversations with multi-AI support to gain consumer insights.
representativeQueries: talk to a Gen Z persona to understand their mindset
simulate a conversation with a young Japanese consumer
get Gen Z perspective on a product or campaign
interview an AI persona for consumer research

entries.description: A decision-first ad strategy tool. Analyzes campaign intent (comparison/learning/transaction/impulse), runs a multi-agent AdCP simulation across 4 media channels (TikTok, YouTube, Google, Meta), selects a scenario, and generates a numeric media plan. JS-calculated budget numbers, AI-generated rationale.
representativeQueries: what media channels should I allocate my ad budget to
compare ad strategy scenarios for a campaign
analyze campaign intent and recommend media allocation
generate a media plan from a campaign brief

entries.description: A PoC implementation of AdCP (Ad Context Protocol) Buyer Agent UI. Visualizes multi-round negotiation between Seller Agents, allocation convergence logic, and Human Decision Layer. Outputs Strategy Transfer JSON for downstream tools.
representativeQueries: simulate ad buying negotiation between media seller agents
visualize budget allocation convergence across media channels
run AdCP buyer agent simulation

entries.description: A data-driven benchmark media planning tool. Optimizes ad budget allocation based on past CPA performance. Includes Google Ads RSA campaign auto-builder, AdCP Brief export, Intent Strength/Type analysis, and CSV import. Multi-AI: Claude, Gemini, GPT-4o.
representativeQueries: optimize ad budget allocation based on past CPA data
build a Google search ads RSA campaign structure
calculate expected conversions from media budget
generate a benchmark media plan for a campaign

entries.description: A customer strategy design tool with a strict 3-4 turn conversation flow and 4 AI modes (normal / expand / narrow / Yuta). Designed not as an analysis tool but as a device to move thinking forward. Powered by Gemini API.
representativeQueries: design a customer strategy for a product
clarify target customer definition
think through customer segmentation
challenge assumptions about our target audience

entries.description: A mind mapping tool that visualizes thoughts as nodes and edges. Interactively explores relationships and resonance structures between ideas. Supports Think Drill JSON import.
representativeQueries: visualize relationships between ideas
create a mind map for a strategy
explore concept connections interactively
map out the structure of a complex topic

entries.description: A 3-AI integrated personal user manual for team members. Includes back manual for subordinates, quiz, and 3-level certification test. Built with pure HTML+JS, fully compatible with iPhone Safari.
representativeQueries: how does Yuta Terachi work and think
onboard a new team member to Yuta's working style
test knowledge of Yuta's management philosophy
understand how to collaborate with the GMSD head

entries.description: A strategic alignment tool that generates a 'North Star' success definition from free-text input. Uses three AI models (Claude Sonnet, Gemini 2.5 Flash, GPT-4o) in parallel to produce a Strategic Contradiction, Desired Relationship State, and Relationship Futures. Outputs PDF with Japanese font support.
representativeQueries: define a north star vision for a business strategy
align a team around a shared success definition
generate strategic direction from ambiguous goals
clarify what success looks like for a campaign or project

entries.description: A multi-AI creative diagnostic tool using synthetic personas to analyze ad creatives. Generates personas from statistical data, document paste, or manual form. Includes Attention Decay Graph and export in HTML/PDF/JSON. Deep crimson × gold aesthetic.
representativeQueries: analyze an ad creative through synthetic consumer personas
generate consumer personas from demographic data
evaluate ad creative resonance across different audience types
diagnose creative effectiveness with AI personas

entries.description: A strategic decision-support tool where Claude-generated agents tailored to any theme run a 4-step sequence: generateAgents → generateConflicts → generateOptions → generateDebate. Features Conflict Map, Human Decision Layer, Meeting Minutes with agent stances, and PDF/JSON export.
representativeQueries: run a multi-agent debate on a strategic decision
generate conflicting perspectives on a business problem
create a structured decision framework with AI agents
simulate stakeholder debate before making a key decision
